text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with 
Calstone Light O, we passed by the 
wharf...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeeees♪ Nyahaha, your belly's totally out. 
Wanna take a nap together~?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, nuzzling up to me like this... Jeez, 
you really are cute, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
A kitty! It's a kitty! So jealous, I wanna 
pet it too—!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: N-n-n-n-n-n-n-n-nyaaaaaaaaat!

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Fgyah!? Hssss!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Aah, kitty! I'm sorry, wait...! Ugh, I 
messed up.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, she hid in the bushes. Really, 
Right O, you rushed in a bit too fast.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't worry about it. She's just a bit 
on her guard, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"It's frustrating. I'm disappointed in 
myself. How can one get them to be so fond 
of you?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, maybe... avoid making sudden, jerky 
movements? I've also heard high-pitched 
voices work well, yes.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's it, that's it♪ Just chilling out 
like us! Ah, feeding them might be the 
quickest way, though~

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I see, in that case—!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—I've bought the snacks. Don't move too 
quickly, stay relaxed. And speak in a 
high-pitched voice, was it?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...Here, kitty, kitty, kitty. Come here, 
come here, come heeeere.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
A-A falsetto!? Standing at total attention 
like that...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You wanna get closer to them that badly?! 
Umm, maybe try acting a li~ttle more 
natural...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Here, kitty, kitty... Come heeeere.

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text:
H-Hnyaaa? Mnyaaa~~...!? Hissss! 
Hiiissssss!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
They're totally suspicious of me...! 
Ugh... This is bad...

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: ――! Meow!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "Kitty, where are you going?! Ah...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa. What's with you? Rushing around 
like that... Heh.

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: *purr* *purr* *purr*♡ Meooowww♡

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's so attached to you! That's 
amaaazing~.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —Why?!”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well now... cats generally prefer quiet 
folks, after all.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Guhh, this is painful. So very painful. I 
wanna fluff the kitty's fur too...
choice_data_list: Light O, I've still got treats over here!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right. I'll go give it to them real 
quietly.

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Vvv~~... Hiss—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The cat snatched the treat and bolted at 
full speed..."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Guh...!
choice_data_list:
Still, the cat seems happy with the 
treats.
Let's get closer, little by little!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. I'm sure they will enjoy eating 
it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
A kitty's happiness comes first. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to become friends too! I'm so 
jealous of everyone! So envious!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
S-So honest...! Did you really have to say 
your internal monologue out loud?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Seriously～. How should I put it, she's 
completely different from us. Don't you 
think, Taishin-san?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O's overly straightforward 
words seemed to spark something in the 
three of them...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I want to be friends soon. But alas, you 
can't force how a cat feels.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, you'll get along eventually. 
Hey, wanna all grab some tea together? We 
can talk about cats or—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Let's! Talk about cats! Absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Talk about a quick pivot... Ah, well, I'm 
heading ho—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Nature said "everyone." Does that not 
include you as well?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, well there's no turning that down, 
Taishin-san♪ Alrighty then, shall we head 
off~?
